# Data Source: tfe_no_code_module

Gets a public or private existing no-code module.

## Example Usage

```typescript
import * as constructs from "constructs";
import * as cdktf from "cdktf";
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import * as tfe from "./.gen/providers/tfe";
class MyConvertedCode extends cdktf.TerraformStack {
  constructor(scope: constructs.Construct, name: string) {
    super(scope, name);
    const tfeOrganizationFoobar = new tfe.organization.Organization(
      this,
      "foobar",
      {
        email: "admin@company.com",
        name: "my-org-name",
      }
    );
    const tfeRegistryModuleFoobar = new tfe.registryModule.RegistryModule(
      this,
      "foobar_1",
      {
        moduleProvider: "my_provider",
        name: "test_module",
        organization: cdktf.Token.asString(tfeOrganizationFoobar.id),
      }
    );
    /*This allows the Terraform resource name to match the original name. You can remove the call if you don't need them to match.*/
    tfeRegistryModuleFoobar.overrideLogicalId("foobar");
    const tfeNoCodeModuleFoobar = new tfe.noCodeModule.NoCodeModule(
      this,
      "foobar_2",
      {
        organization: cdktf.Token.asString(tfeOrganizationFoobar.id),
        registryModule: cdktf.Token.asString(tfeRegistryModuleFoobar.id),
      }
    );
    /*This allows the Terraform resource name to match the original name. You can remove the call if you don't need them to match.*/
    tfeNoCodeModuleFoobar.overrideLogicalId("foobar");
    const dataTfeNoCodeModuleFoobar =
      new tfe.dataTfeNoCodeModule.DataTfeNoCodeModule(this, "foobar_3", {
        id: cdktf.Token.asString(tfeNoCodeModuleFoobar.id),
      });
    /*This allows the Terraform resource name to match the original name. You can remove the call if you don't need them to match.*/
    dataTfeNoCodeModuleFoobar.overrideLogicalId("foobar");
  }
}

```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the no-code module.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates if this no-code module is currently enabled.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the no-code module.
- `organization` (String) Name of the organization.
- `registryModuleId` (String) ID of the registry module.
- `versionPin` (String) Version pin of the no-code module.
